import json,collections
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
calls=json.loads('${JSON.stringify(c)}')
assert len(rows)==len(calls)
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for n,(r,(s,p)) in enumerate(zip(rows,calls),1):
  note='Slot 1 is printed ѣ.' if n in (52,76) else ''
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):v for i,v in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918=p,note=note),ensure_ascii=False)+'
')
a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(rows)
for r,v in zip(rows,a):
 assert r['item_id']==v['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(r['slots'])}
 assert set(v['slots'])==expected,(r['item_id'],expected,v['slots'])
 assert set(v['confidence'])==expected
 assert set(v['slots'].values())<={'ъ','ь','other','u'}
 assert set(v['confidence'].values())<={'high','low'}
 assert v['pre1918'] in {'yes','no','unclear'}
c=collections.Counter(x for v in a for x in v['slots'].values())
print('Validated item count, order, and slot coverage:',len(a))
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(v['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for v in a))
